name: ecommerce-reviews-and-ratings
description: Owns the record that somebody expressed an opinion about a product, and the merchant's decision about whether that expression is displayed.
features: Append-only review and rating expressions that supersede on edit
Moderation decisions as an actor-attributed audit trail
Reproducible displayed rating aggregates that name their population
Tri-state verified purchase over an optional purchase seam
Idempotent helpfulness votes, one row per voter per expression
Merchant replies as moderated expressions in their own right
Automated content screening that queues for a person, never rejects
Closed-enum moderation, flag and incentive-disclosure reasons
Syndicated and imported review history that says it is imported
GDPR export and redaction that leaves published aggregates unmoved
